object.name: InputLocationMessageContent
object.description: Represents the content of a location message to be sent as the result of an inline query.
object.html_description: Represents the content of a location message to be sent as the result of an inline query.
object.rst_description: Represents the `content <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmessagecontent>`_ of a location message to be sent as the result of an inline query.

annotations.name: latitude
annotations.description: Latitude of the location in degrees
annotations.rst_description: Latitude of the location in degrees

annotations.name: longitude
annotations.description: Longitude of the location in degrees
annotations.rst_description: Longitude of the location in degrees

annotations.name: horizontal_accuracy
annotations.description: Optional. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500
annotations.html_description: Optional. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500

annotations.name: live_period
annotations.description: Optional. Period in seconds during which the location can be updated, must be between 60 and 86400, or 0x7FFFFFFF for live locations that can be edited indefinitely
annotations.html_description: Optional. Period in seconds during which the location can be updated, must be between 60 and 86400, or 0x7FFFFFFF for live locations that can be edited indefinitely
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Period in seconds during which the location can be updated, must be between 60 and 86400, or 0x7FFFFFFF for live locations that can be edited indefinitely

annotations.name: heading
annotations.description: Optional. For live locations, a direction in which the user is moving, in degrees. Must be between 1 and 360 if specified.
annotations.html_description: Optional. For live locations, a direction in which the user is moving, in degrees. Must be between 1 and 360 if specified.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. For live locations, a direction in which the user is moving, in degrees. Must be between 1 and 360 if specified.

annotations.name: proximity_alert_radius
annotations.description: Optional. For live locations, a maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.
annotations.html_description: Optional. For live locations, a maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. For live locations, a maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. Must be between 1 and 100000 if specified.
